Default.note: Work / Case studies / Northwind. Ancestors muted, current page in foreground black, chevron separators at the right 3.5 size. Calm and correct.

Shallow.note: Two-level trail with a long current-page title; wraps cleanly and the muted/foreground contrast still reads.

SlashSeparator.note: Custom slash children render in place of the chevron and sit on the baseline with the links. Reads as a path, as intended.

AbovePageTitle.note: In-situ composition: trail, text-h3 title over two lines, text-meta byline. Spacing is even and the hierarchy is unambiguous.
